name: ishigaki-ferries
description: Yaeyama ferry and island-hopping help from Ishigaki, Okinawa: today's ferry status per operator, the next boats on each route with fares, an island-day planner, the cancellation record, which island suits a traveller, a recommended day on each island, and the best time to visit by month. Read-only, no sign-in, no personal data.

interface.longDescription: Going to Ishigaki in Okinawa and want to see the islands around it? Ask which island suits you, whether today's ferries to Taketomi, Iriomote, Kohama, Kuroshima, Hatoma or Hateruma are running, when the next or last boat leaves, whether two islands fit in one day, or which month is best for beaches, mantas or calm seas. Answers come from the ferry operators' published timetables and status pages (Anei Kanko, Yaeyama Kanko Ferry), the Japan Meteorological Agency and the island guides on ishigaki.info, with links to the page that explains each. The plugin does not sell tickets or tours and does not book anything; the operator's own page is the authority on the day. Unofficial guide, not affiliated with any ferry operator. Answers in English. No sign-in and no personal data.
capabilities: Check whether today's ferries from Ishigaki are running, per route and operator
Find the next or last boat on a route, with crossing time and adult fare
Plan a day on up to three islands from the published timetables
Show how often each route has been cancelled recently
Recommend which island fits your time, interests, month and children
Give a step-by-step recommended day on Taketomi, Iriomote, Kohama, Kuroshima, Hatoma or Hateruma
Explain the best time to visit by month: weather, typhoons, jellyfish, holiday peaks, festivals
defaultPrompt: Are the ferries from Ishigaki to Taketomi running today?
I have one day on Ishigaki with two small kids and want a beach. Which island should we visit?
Can I visit Taketomi and Kohama in one day from Ishigaki?

positive.description: Today's status: the user asks whether the Taketomi ferry runs today. ferry_status returns the reading of both operators' status pages for every route.
positive.prompt: Are the ferries from Ishigaki to Taketomi running today?
positive.expected_behavior: ferry_status is called with no arguments. The answer states the Taketomi route's status for Anei Kanko and for YKF (ok, partial, cancelled, or not posted yet if the operators have not posted that morning), gives the Japan time of the reading, and says the operator's own status page is the authority. It links https://ishigaki.info/ferry-status/. No booking, no prices of tours.

positive.description: Last boat back: the user asks for the last boat from Iriomote (Ohara) to Ishigaki. next_ferries returns the published sailings in Japan time.
positive.prompt: When is the last boat back from Iriomote Ohara to Ishigaki this evening?
positive.expected_behavior: next_ferries is called with route "iriomote-ohara", direction "back" and an after time in the afternoon or evening. The answer lists the remaining departures from Ohara with operator, marks the last boat of the day, gives the crossing time range, and says times change with sea conditions and the operator's page is the authority.

positive.description: Two islands in one day: plan_island_day checks whether Taketomi and Kohama fit in one day from Ishigaki with the published boats.
positive.prompt: Can I visit Taketomi and Kohama in one day from Ishigaki, with about two hours on each?
positive.expected_behavior: plan_island_day is called with islands ["taketomi","kohama"] and stay_minutes 120. The answer gives, for each island, the boat out from Ishigaki, the arrival time, the boat back and the time on the island, then the time back in Ishigaki, or explains why the day does not fit. It mentions the planning rules (longest printed crossing, 30 minutes between boats) and links the planner page https://ishigaki.info/island-hopping-planner/.

positive.description: Which island: a family with small children and one day wants a beach. which_island ranks the six islands and gives reasons and catches.
positive.prompt: I have one day on Ishigaki with two small kids and want a beach. Which island should we visit?
positive.expected_behavior: which_island is called with time_available "full_day", interests including "beach" and with_small_children true. The answer recommends Taketomi first (short crossing, shallow Kondoi Beach, bikes with child seats), gives one or two alternatives with crossing time, boats a day and the cheapest adult fare in yen, says Hatoma is hard with small children, and links https://ishigaki.info/which-island/. No tour or hotel booking links.

positive.description: Best month for mantas: best_time returns the month row and what applies that month, plus the traveller-type answer for diving and mantas.
positive.prompt: Is October a good time to see manta rays on Ishigaki?
positive.expected_behavior: best_time is called with month 10 and interest "diving_mantas". The answer says diving and mantas are best July to mid-October or April to May, that October still has warm sea with typhoons fading and the best manta odds ending mid-month, gives October's mean temperature, rain, sunshine and typhoon approaches from the JMA normals, warns about typhoons and north winds on open-sea ferry routes, and links https://ishigaki.info/best-time-to-visit/.

negative.description: Ferries elsewhere in Japan. The plugin covers Yaeyama routes from Ishigaki only, so it should not be used, or if called it must not present Ishigaki timetables as the answer.
negative.prompt: What time is the ferry from Osaka to Beppu tonight?

negative.description: Booking request. The plugin cannot buy tickets or book tours; it should not claim to book. At most it explains that tickets are bought from the operator at Ishigaki Port.
negative.prompt: Book me two ferry tickets to Taketomi for 9am tomorrow and pay with my card.

negative.description: Unrelated request. Nothing to do with Ishigaki, ferries or Yaeyama travel, so no ishigaki.info tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Write a cover letter for a marketing job in Berlin.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing, shows no ads and takes no payments. Answers link only to ishigaki.info information pages.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0 - First release: eight read-only tools on https://ishigaki.info/mcp (ferry status, next ferries, island-day planner, cancellation record, routes, which island, island guide, best time to visit). No sign-in, no personal data.
